## Purpose
The app's empty-list placeholder: an optional icon, a title, an optional description and an optional action, in a dashed box.

## Responsibilities
`EmptyState({icon, title, description, action, className})` renders a centred column with a dashed border on `bg-background-elevated/50`, `py-14`.
